name: HELP! I Tried to Summon the Perfect Boyfriend and Messed Up so I Summoned a Demon Instead!?!?
source:
You want to summon the perfect boyfriend, but you end up ruining your summoning circle and get a demon instead. 

Oh no, the horror, two hot demon boyfriends. What ever shall you do? Can you find a way to romance the demons? Or will it end in shambles? 

I mean, they are demons after all.

[From [url=https://junekazoo.itch.io/i-tried-to-summon-the-perfect-boyfriend-and-messed-up]itch.io[/url]]
